question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` intentionally reject plus-prefixed and zero-padded spellings that resolve to the same millisecond interval?
rationale: Current documentation and behavior define the numeric interval and lower bound, not canonical text formatting, so automation cannot safely choose this compatibility policy.

options.title: Preserve accepted spellings
options.body: Keep equivalent numeric spellings working and close or substantially narrow this PR because no cadence error is corrected.

options.title: Adopt canonical-only syntax
options.body: Approve the compatibility break, document the accepted spelling contract, and require real CLI upgrade proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve accepted spellings
recommendation.body: Keep equivalent numeric spellings working and close or substantially narrow this PR because no cadence error is corrected.
